W.name: Rocket Jump
W.title: Template:Data Tristana/Rocket Jump
W.wikitext:
{{{{{1<noinclude>|Ability data</noinclude>}}}|Rocket Jump|{{{2|}}}|{{{3|}}}|{{{4|}}}|{{{5|}}}
|champion     = Tristana
|skill        = W
|icon         = Rocket Jump.png
|blurb        = {{sbc|Active:}} {{ci|Tristana}} jumps to the target location. Upon landing, she deals {{as|magic damage}} and {{tip|slows}} nearby enemies for a short time.
|blurb2      = When '''Tristana''' scores an enemy {{tip|champion}} {{tip|takedown}} or detonates ''{{ai|Explosive Charge|Tristana}}'' at max stacks on a champion, it will {{sti|cdr|reset}} ''Rocket Jump's'' cooldown.
|description  = {{sbc|Active:}} '''Tristana''' {{tip|dash|jumps}} to the target location. Upon landing, she deals {{as|magic damage}} to nearby enemies and {{tip|slows}} them by 40% for 2 seconds.
|leveling     = {{st|Magic Damage|{{ap|70 to 210}} {{as|(+ 100% '''bonus''' AD)}} {{as|(+ 50% AP)}}}}
|description2 = Scoring an enemy {{tip|champion}} {{tip|takedown}} or detonating ''{{ai|Explosive Charge|Tristana}}'' at maximum stacks on a champion will reset ''Rocket Jump's'' {{sti|cooldown}}.
|description3 = '''''Tristana''' can cast any of her [[champion ability|abilities]] during the dash.''
|cooldown     = {{ap|22 to 14}}
|cost         = {{ap|30 to 50}}
|costtype     = mana
|target range = {{tip|cr|icononly = true}} {{tt|900|Maximum dash distance}}<!--has a minimum dash range, needs to be measured-->
|targeting    = Location
|cast time    = {{fd|0.25}}
|effect radius= {{tip|cr|icononly = true}} 350
|speed        = {{tt|1100|Can differ based on dash range/terrain interference}}
|affects      = Enemies / Self
|damagetype   = Magic
|spelleffects = spellaoe
|spellshield  = True
|projectile   = 
|knockdown    = True
|grounded     = True
|outofrange   = cast at max
|notes        = 
* '''Tristana''' can still use her [[champion ability|abilities]], [[summoner spell]]s, and [[active ability items|item actives]] during ''Rocket Jump''.
* ''Rocket Jump's'' dash speed depends on the distance of the jump. Close-ranged jumps are much shorter while long-ranged jumps leave '''Tristana''' in the air significantly longer.
* If '''Tristana''' has less than 850 movement speed, a full-range ''Rocket Jump'' (including its cast time) will make her arrive quicker at its destination than walking at this speed could.
* Killing {{tip|clone|clones}} or detonating {{ai|Explosive Charge|Tristana}} on them also resets ''Rocket Jump's'' cooldown.
** The former may be unintended.
}}

E.name: Explosive Charge
E.title: Template:Data Tristana/Explosive Charge
E.wikitext:
<!-- The following values are defined as parameters.
-->{{#vardefine:e_p1|45}}<!-- PASSIVE rank 1 magic damage
-->{{#vardefine:e_p5|105}}<!-- PASSIVE rank 5 magic damage
-->{{#vardefine:e_p_ap|25}}<!-- PASSIVE AP ratio
-->{{#vardefine:e_a1|60}}<!-- ACTIVE rank 1 base damage
-->{{#vardefine:e_a5|160}}<!-- ACTIVE rank 5 base damage
-->{{#vardefine:e_a_ad|80}}<!-- ACTIVE bonus AD ratio as a PERCENTAGE
-->{{#vardefine:e_a_ap|50}}<!-- ACTIVE AP ratio as a PERCENTAGE
-->{{#vardefine:e_a_s|0.25}}<!-- ACTIVE bonus damage per stack as a DECIMAL
-->{{#vardefine:e_a_c|0.75}}<!-- ACTIVE crit chance scaling as a DECIMAL
-->{{{{{1<noinclude>|Ability data</noinclude>}}}|Explosive Charge|{{{2|}}}|{{{3|}}}|{{{4|}}}|{{{5|}}}
|champion     = Tristana
|skill        = E
|icon         = false
|blurb        = {{sbc|Passive:}} Enemies explode when killed by {{cis|Tristana}} basic attacks, dealing {{as|magic damage}} to nearby enemies.
|blurb2       = {{sbc|Active:}} '''Tristana''' tosses an explosive charge that attaches to the target enemy for a few seconds. The charge then explodes to deal {{as|physical damage}} to nearby enemies, increased based on {{as|{{sti|critical strike chance}}}}.
|blurb3       = '''Tristana's''' {{tip|basic attacks}} and {{tip|abilities}} against the target will increase the charge's damage. Upon reaching the cap, the charge explodes instantly.
|blurb4       = The charge can target and damage {{tip|turrets}} and explodes farther on a turret.
|description  = {{sbc|Passive:}} '''Tristana's''' basic attacks are empowered to trigger an explosion when they kill the target, dealing {{as|magic damage}} to nearby enemies.
|leveling     = {{st|Magic Damage|{{ap|{{#var:e_p1}} to {{#var:e_p5}}}} {{as|(+ {{#var:e_p_ap}}% AP)}}}}
|icon2        = Explosive Charge.png
|description2 = {{sbc|Active:}} '''Tristana''' tosses an explosive charge at the target enemy that attaches to them for 4 seconds. The charge then detonates, dealing {{as|physical damage}} to nearby enemies. ''Explosive Charge'' can target and damage {{tip|turrets}}, and explodes in a larger radius on a turret.
|leveling2    = {{st|Minimum Physical Damage|{{ap|{{#var:e_a1}} to {{#var:e_a5}}}} {{as|(+ {{#var:e_a_ad}}% '''bonus''' AD)}} {{as|(+ {{#var:e_a_ap}}% AP)}}}}
|description3 = '''Tristana's''' {{tip|basic attacks}} {{tip|on-hit}} and {{tip|abilities}} against the target increase ''Explosive Charge's'' damage by {{ap|{{#var:e_a_s}}*100}}%, {{tip|stack|stacking}} up to 4 times for a maximum {{ap|{{#var:e_a_s}}*400}}% increase, upon which the charge also detonates instantly. The charge's '''total''' damage is additionally increased by {{critical damage|0 to 40|critScaling=true}}.
|leveling3    = {{st|Bonus Damage Per Stack|{{ap|({{#var:e_a1}} to {{#var:e_a5}})*{{#var:e_a_s}}}} {{as|(+ {{ap|{{#var:e_a_ad}}*{{#var:e_a_s}}}}% '''bonus''' AD)}} {{as|(+ {{ap|{{#var:e_a_ap}}*{{#var:e_a_s}}}}% AP)}}|Full Stack Bonus Damage|{{ap|({{#var:e_a1}} to {{#var:e_a5}})*({{#var:e_a_s}}*4)}} {{as|(+ {{ap|{{#var:e_a_ad}}*({{#var:e_a_s}}*4)}}% '''bonus''' AD)}} {{as|(+ {{ap|{{#var:e_a_ap}}*({{#var:e_a_s}}*4)}}% AP)}}}}
{{st|Full Stack Physical Damage|{{ap|({{#var:e_a1}} to {{#var:e_a5}})*(1+{{#var:e_a_s}}*4)}} {{as|(+ {{ap|{{#var:e_a_ad}}*(1+{{#var:e_a_s}}*4)}}% '''bonus''' AD)}} {{as|(+ {{ap|{{#var:e_a_ap}}*(1+{{#var:e_a_s}}*4)}}% AP)}}}}
|description4 = ''If {{ai|Buster Shot|Tristana}} is used to apply the last stack, the detonation will instead be delayed until the end of the {{tip|airborne|knock back}} or the 4 seconds expire.''
|cooldown     = {{ap|16 to 14}}
|cdstart      = on-cast
|cost         = {{ap|50 to 70}}
|costtype     = mana 
|target range = {{tip|er|icononly = true}} {{pp|550 to 700}}
|effect radius= {{dv|{{tip|cr|icononly = true}} {{tt|300|Passive}}|{{tt|300|Active}}|{{tt|600|Active (turret)}}}}
|cast time    = {{as|100% of '''Tristana's''' windup time|as}} ({{fd|{{#expr:(1/{{ccd|Tristana|as_base}})*{{ccd|Tristana|windup}}round2}}}} at {{as|'''base''' attack speed}})
|speed        = 2400
|targeting    = Unit
|affects      = Enemies
|damagetype   = Physical
|spelleffects = spellaoe
|spellshield  = True
|projectile   = True
|knockdown    = 
|parry        = special
|callforhelp  = True
|grounded     = 
|notes        = 
* ''Explosive Charge's'' cast time is always 100% of the caster's attack windup time.
** At base attack speed, '''Tristana's''' attack windup is {{fd|0.225625}} seconds.
** An easy formula to calculate the cast time is [ {{fd|0.14801}} seconds divided by {{as|'''total''' attack speed|attack speed}} ].
** Reducing '''Tristana's''' attack speed via {{tip|cripple|attack speed reductions}} also increases ''Explosive Charge's'' cast time by the same fraction.
** It is calculated from '''Tristana's''' total attack speed after cap ({{fd|3.003}}) and floor ({{fd|0.2}}), making the maximum possible cast time {{rutngt|0.74005}}.
* '''Tristana''' will be automatically ordered to basic attack the target after the cast time.
* ''Explosive Charge's'' initial application deals 0 {{as|physical|physical damage}} {{tt|damage|sourcetype pending for test, but probably proc}}, triggering {{tip|turret}} aggro.
** It also triggers a {{tip|stack}} of effects such as {{ri|Electrocute}}.
* All explosions by ''Explosive Charge's'' passive count as the same cast instance. Every cast of the active is a separate cast instance:
** Hitting a champion with the passive by killing a nearby unit, casting the active on them (see note above) and landing a basic attack against them triggers {{ri|Electrocute}}.
** Hitting a champion with the passive by killing a nearby unit, casting the active on them and hitting them again with the Passive by killing another nearby unit does '''not''' trigger {{ri|Electrocute}}.
* {{tip|Dodge}}, {{tip|block}} and {{tip|blind}} all prevent ''Explosive Charge's'' stack application via basic attacks.
* ''Explosive Charge's'' detonation will deal damage to the primary target even if they have become {{tip|untargetable}}.
* ''Explosive Charge's'' stacks from basic attacks are applied as an {{tip|on-hit}} effect and will therefore interact with {{iis|Guinsoo's Rageblade}} Phantom Hit and {{iis|Runaan's Hurricane}} bolts.
{{Unit-targeted cancel conditions}}
}}
